EOD: 15:20 full remaining SOR MARKET DAY intent; first admissible15:20<=t<15:25 actualO, else valid exact15:30 O=H=L=C auction, else fail-closed.
MTM: MTM_LAST_ACTUAL_TRADE_SAME_SESSION_V1; actual Entry anchor and later closed actual trade only. Never fill/cash release.
North_star_scope: 20 supplied Development evaluation sessions; unobserved noncohort days not imputed.

allocation.MAX_semantics: MAX stops additional position identities. Lots added to already selected funded positions do not increase concurrent count.
allocation.caps: Caps apply to effective cash debit conservatively including BUY5bps once; anchored at pre-batch equity. No Equity/N allocation.
allocation.first_pass: Select up to free MAX slots at this Entry timestamp; score-proportional budget, conservative effective-debit equity/liquidity caps, floor100.
allocation.water_fill: Only initially funded candidates in this Entry batch; score-descending rounds, one100-share lot per candidate/round while target budget,cash,equity/liquidity capacity allow. No later top-ups or new Entry identities.

anatomy.AUC: Higher movement value predicts positive, no posthoc sign reversal
anatomy.bins: Five equal-feature-quantile diagnostic bins; boundaries outcome-blind, duplicate boundaries may leave fewer occupied bins; not funding thresholds.
anatomy.scope: All58 Development diagnostics; OOF38 shown separately

heads.P: Strictly later Entry minute<t<15:20 actual High/raw reference-1>=.05
heads.R: Unconstrained100-share candidate outcome using Frozen EXIT before15:20 when confirmed, else precommitted EOD actual fill; SELL effective/BUY effective-1>0; unresolved=None, training/eval only.

improvement_status_rule: If any2x =>HIT; else compare selected v2 and frozen v1 best lexicographically(hit rate,rolling20 median,daily geom), greater=>IMPROVED_BUT_MISS, otherwiseNO_IMPROVEMENT; zero valid windows=>BLOCKED; integrity failure=>CONTRACT_FAIL.
limit_up: LIMIT_UP_POSITION_HANDLING_V2; authoritative causal source only, otherwise UNKNOWN and continue normal EOD. No future liquidity exception.

model.fit_plan: 8 CORE_P fits +8 MOVE_P fits +8 MOVE_R fits =24 unique fits. ARM-C shares exactly ARM-B P artifacts, no redundant fit.
model.preprocessing: Training-only mean/std on numeric0+missing indicators; training vocabulary onehot with explicitUNKNOWN
model.priority: Reuse v1 audited sklearn L2 logistic pipeline; adapt only precommitted field lists and second fixed teacher
model.training: First20 supplied Dev sessions warmup;5-session expanding-origin blocks; train only completed past sessions, Entry<15:20 and available teacher; same test block for both heads.

movement_signal_rule.SUPPORTED: effect AND OOF P_AUC(B)-A>=.01 AND pre-cutoff all-OOF top20% score Winner enrichment B>=A AND mean3MAX funded capture,daily geom,rolling20 median B>=A, with one capture/portfolio metric strictly higher
movement_signal_rule.WEAK: At least1 ofM1-M12 meets effect thresholds AND at least1 of OOF P_AUC,capture,daily geom,rolling20 median improves B>A; else NOT_SUPPORTED
movement_signal_rule.effect: M2 std_difference>=.20 and AUC>=.55, plus at least4 ofM1-M12 with both>=.20/.55
movement_signal_rule.top20_population: All pre-cutoff OOF candidates; deterministic score ordering, ceil(.2*N). Also report extreme-liquidity eligible subset.

prior_cycle: v1 retained formal negative; no rerun or modifications

scores.deterministic_tie: CapitalScore descending, Entry timestamp, symbol stable order

selection_final_exact_tie: Fixed arm order CORE_P5,MOVE_P5,MOVE_DUAL solely if every specified metric and MAX are exactly tied.
source_arrival: Actual arrival UNKNOWN; inherited availability minute+1/bar_end assumption. Past sessions available16:30. No future source availability gate.
